title: The Black Knight Knelt to Me
summary: A legendary knight walks past the prince and kneels to a quiet stable boy. When the king orders their arrest, the boy lifts the knight’s sword and the entire guard bows.
frame_0: Over Raven Crown’s shoulder, the stable boy holds his straw broom in front of the throne. The title reads THE BLACK KNIGHT / KNELT TO ME.
package_differences: Jake’s November 23 addendum adds the on-screen line PART 2 IS ON MY PROFILE. at 126.70 seconds. It stays above the narration captions through the two-second final-picture hold and clears on the cut to the Flashloop phone at 130.70 seconds. The voice is the supplied recording.
sponsor_approval: Hold as a draft for Flashloop approval.
